material.acceptance_criteria: A window blur releases the modifiers the pack holds (a forwarded up per held modifier, or a blur action). A ground press after refocus carries shift=false unless shift is physically down.
material.description: play.js:1262 handles window blur by clearing keysDown only. It sends no key release for held modifiers. The pack takes shift, ctrl and alt only from key events (controls.lua:427-428), and each ground press copies shift from that state (controls.lua:475). A shift keydown followed by focus loss (alt-tab) never delivers its keyup to the page, so s.held.shift stays true until another key event arrives. The next right-click then passes shift as the queued flag (controls.lua:490, order_selected at controls.lua:231). Symptom: after returning to the game, a plain right-click queues the move instead of replacing the order.
material.subject: Modifier keys stay held in the pack after the window loses focus
material.witness: Live page (verify-illegal-trav-input-client-3), pack dispatch spy: keydown Shift then window blur. Before the fix the blur sent no key event after shift down (dispatch 1792859828185-6599-dc1cafad6b690914). After the fix it sent key shift up with shift false (dispatch 1792859865102-6619-466d4037f6a6d6b8).
